daily.summary: Amidst a troubling decline in stock markets, Asian nations are mobilizing their financial strategies. daily.title: Treasury Futures Fall as Rising Stock Futures Damp Haven Demand
daily.summary: US Treasury futures declined as demand for havens waned on signs that the recent selloff in equities may be drawing some buyers back. Futures on 10-year Treasury notes fell 9/32 to 106 18/32 in early trading in Asia on Monday, the equivalent of a roughly four-basis-point advance. There’s no cash trading in the Asia session due to a public holiday in Japan. The move comes as US equity-index futures gained following a rout that was sparked by an unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade.

daily.title: Fed officials are chatting up a storm. Investors are in the dark about their plans.
daily.summary: The Federal Reserve is almost certain to raise interest rates next month to cool inflation. But the size of the increase is anyone’s guess. With the central bank’s Dec. 8-9 policy meeting less than three weeks away, Fed officials are entertaining an unusually wide range of possibilities. Some favor moving quickly to contain inflation, while others want to proceed cautiously as financial conditions tighten and concerns about the artificial-intelligence boom mount. Complicating matters is Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh’s retreat from forward guidance, the practice of signaling the likely direction of monetary policy.

daily.title: CBIC Proposes Changes to Section 16 and New Section 16A to Protect Genuine ITC Claims
daily.summary: CBIC proposes changes to Section 16 & new Section 16A to protect genuine ITC claims, aiming to prevent penalising recipients for supplier defaults. The proposal seeks to bring greater clarity to ITC eligibility and ensure that bona fide recipients are not penalised merely because of defaults committed by suppliers or other persons in the supply chain. At the same time, it aims to prevent taxpayers knowingly involved in fraudulent transactions from claiming ITC. The proposals form part of an agenda note prepared by the GST Policy Wing of CBIC following deliberations at the 57th GST Council meeting.

daily.title: The decade India turned the tide on poverty
daily.summary: The World Bank report highlights that nearly 50 crore Indians have moved out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. Government efforts include health initiatives and direct benefit transfers that empower households. Women's participation in self-help groups has transformed economic opportunities for many. Continued investment in infrastructure aims to support future growth and prevent slippage back into poverty. Achieving Viksit Bharat by 2047 remains a shared goal for India's development.

daily.title: India-EU trade deal likely to be signed on December 16
daily.summary: Described as the 'mother of all deals', the FTA will provide duty-free access to the EU for 93% of India's exports, while making imports of luxury cars and wines from the bloc cheaper. Together, India and the EU account for 25% of global GDP and about one-third of international trade, valued at $11 trillion of the $33 trillion global trade market.

daily.title: West Bengal govt in talks with farmers to acquire 997 acres in Singur: CM
daily.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari on Sunday said his government was in talks with farmers to acquire 997 acres of land in Singur in Hooghly district, a day after Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar announced Ashok Leyland would set up a truck manufacturing plant there. Singur was the site of Tata Motors' Nano small-car factory, for which the then Left Front government acquired around 997 acres in 2006. The acquisition triggered a prolonged farmers' agitation led by Mamata Banerjee, following which Tata Motors moved the project to Sanand in Gujarat in 2008.

daily.title: From cotton mills to cityscapes – How the Singhanias are unlocking legacy land
daily.summary: The 104-year-old JK group company is betting on a ₹965-crore hospitality push and a ₹4,400-crore real estate pipeline built on its old industrial land Over a century ago, JK Cotton spun textiles out of Kanpur, before the company diversified into other businesses. Renamed JK Urbanscapes in 2023, the 104-year-old company, which attempted a brief revival of its textile business in 2009, is now betting on a bigger prize: turning old industrial and mill land into hospitality and urban real estate.

daily.title: SEBI starts work on network to train independent directors
daily.summary: SEBI begins building a network with industry and academia to train independent directors amid rising startup and IPO activity. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has started working on a wider capacity-building network to train and upgrade the skills of independent directors, bringing together professional industry bodies and academic institutions to develop programmes aimed at improving boardroom oversight, according to people familiar with the developments. The discussions centred on how the institutions could collaborate on developing training programmes, sharing expertise and creating a wider pool of resources for independent directors.

daily.title: Ahead of FY28 budget, aluminium product makers seek duty-free imports for primary metal
daily.summary: Ahead of the Union Budget 2027-28, aluminium manufacturers' body ALEMAI has urged the government to reduce the basic customs duty on primary aluminium from 7.5% to zero, citing high input costs and the impact on MSME competitiveness. Manufacturers' body ALEMAI has written a letter to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, seeking to bring down the basic customs duty on primary aluminium to zero, arguing that the current 7.5 per cent levy, which translates into an effective import duty of 8.25 per cent including social welfare surcharge, is hurting MSMEs (micro, small and medium enterprises) and domestic value addition.

Road Tax Exemption for Disabled Persons Cannot Be Restricted by Statute: Madras HC
daily.summary: Madras HC directs fresh road tax exemption notification for disabled persons, considering unadapted vehicles and safeguards against misuse. At the same time, the Court recognised the possibility of misuse if exemption were granted without safeguards. Vehicles could be registered in the names of persons with disabilities but used by others, or transferred shortly after purchase. Referring to earlier guidelines governing GST concession certificates for persons with orthopaedic disabilities , the Court identified possible safeguards relating to vehicle specifications, disability certification, income tax returns, declarations concerning previous concessions and restrictions on disposal of vehicles.

daily.title: GSTAT Bengaluru Restores 100% Penalty for Suppressed Turnover Detected During GST Audit
daily.summary: GSTAT Bengaluru restores ₹22.62 lakh GST penalties, holding that audit-triggered disclosure cannot defeat Section 74 suppression proceedings. Summary : The GST Appellate Tribunal, Bengaluru , in Pallawi Anand Vs Sadhana Enviro Engineering Services , allowed the Revenue’s appeal against an appellate order that had deleted or reduced penalties arising from GST audit discrepancies for FY 2018–19. The dispute concerned two distinct categories of tax liability: ₹34,69,134 representing outward tax disclosed in GSTR-1 but not paid through GSTR-3B , and ₹19,02,658 relating to additional taxable receipts and liabilities that came to light through audit scrutiny .

daily.title: CBIC Issues Detailed Guidelines for Implementation of Diamond Imprest Authorisation Scheme: Clarifies 12-Month Import Validity, 18-Month Export Obligation, 10% Value Addition and Customs Duty Exemption
daily.summary: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), Ministry of Finance, Government of India, has issued Circular No. 48/2026-Customs dated November 20, The Circular has been issued to ensure uniform implementation of the Scheme by Customs field formations and to clarify the eligibility conditions, import restrictions, export obligations, documentation requirements, security arrangements and procedures for regularisation of defaults. The Scheme provides for duty-exempt imports of eligible natural cut and polished diamonds against a prescribed obligation to undertake physical exports of natural cut and polished diamonds with minimum value addition.

breaking.title: India's inflation breach: Why the RBI can't afford a timid December
breaking.summary: As food prices race ahead, borrowing booms and foreign flows remain fragile, the size of the repo rate hike matters less than the message the MPC sends The RBI has been steadily absorbing this liquidity using Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) and frequent Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auctions to keep short-term call money interest rates aligned with its main policy rate. With the Consumer Price Index (CPI) crossing the critical limit, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) will clearly take a stricter, more hawkish stance at its December 2026 meeting.

breaking.title: Nirmala Sitharaman Column: 'The decade India turned the tide on poverty’
breaking.summary: India’s poverty-reduction journey under Modi, highlighting targeted schemes, women-led progress, and a vision for a prosperous Viksit Bharat by 2047. A year ago, during my visit to Kiphire, an aspirational district in the remote hills of Nagaland, I interacted with tribal women from local self-help groups. Among them was Esther, a Lakhpati Didi , who proudly spoke of her millet-based products reaching customers online, far beyond Nagaland. What stayed with me was their confidence in a better future. I encouraged them to dream bigger and become Crorepati Didis .
